svg.title: Regular receipt creation and issuance workflow via the POS System API `/sign` and `/issue` endpoints
svg.desc: Swimlane workflow: POS sends /sign ReceiptRequest via the PosSystem API and iPOS to the Queue, gets a signed response, then /issue delivers a digital or printable receipt

text.tspan: Workflow - regular operation (with PosSystem API v2)
